subject: MAP: Security intake & evidence timeline for Greenstream (SIG-lite + DPA addendum)
messages:
From: Emma Lo <emma.lo@greenstreambank.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP: Security intake & evidence timeline for Greenstream (SIG-lite + DPA addendum)

Hi Evelyn / Connor / Irene,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Greenstream is excited about Redwood's latency profile. Before we progress to procurement, our security team asked for a tight mutual action plan focused on gating criteria. Attached is a compact requirements doc (Greenstream_Security_Reqs_v1.pdf) — highlights below:  

- SIG/CAIQ checklist (we're requesting a SIG-lite: top 40 controls) and sample evidence references
- SOC 2: which reports you can provide and expected timeline for any additional evidence collection
- DPA addendum: a few data residency carveouts we need to propose
- Data retention windows: sandbox (0–30d), PII staging (30–90d), production logs (90–365d) — what fits in Redwood's model?

Asks / next steps:  
1) Can you confirm which items are already satisfied by your SOC 2 report vs which we should expect to collect as evidence during the eval?  
2) Proposed MAP cadence: review + evidence intake by 4/27, security review by 5/4, DPA sign by 5/11. Any showstoppers?  
3) We'll need a single point of contact to own evidence uploads (we prefer a named person on your side).

Please loop in Legal if needed; I copied Connor and Irene since they'll coordinate with engineering and security. Gina from Litmus will be available to validate SIG gaps — copying her for visibility.

Attachments: Greenstream_Security_Reqs_v1.pdf

Thanks,
Emma Lo
Head of Security Programs
Greenstream Bank

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Lo <emma.lo@greenstreambank.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Security intake & evidence timeline for Greenstream (SIG-lite + DPA addendum)

Emma — thanks for the clear note and the attachment. We can follow the MAP cadence you proposed with a couple tweaks and a short clarifying plan below.

Quick summary / what we can commit to now:  
- SOC 2: Redwood has a current Type II report (control period through 2026-12-31). We can provide the report and a control narrative immediately. Anything outside the report (e.g., granular console logs) will require an evidence collection window; Connor will scope that.  
- SIG-lite: we can pre-populate 30 of your top 40 items from our internal CAIQ matrix; the remaining items will require brief artifacts/evidence collection (runbook snippets, configuration screenshots).
- DPA addendum: Legal has a draft; I'll attach the MAP template and the addendum draft for review (Redwood_MAP_Template.xlsx, DPA_Addendum_Draft.docx).
- Retention: we support configurable retention tiers — I'll ask Connor to list default windows and what's configurable per-customer.

Proposed revised milestones:  
- 4/22: Redwood sends pre-populated SIG-lite and SOC 2 artifacts
- 4/27: Evidence intake complete for items we requested
- 5/3: Internal security review completed on your side
- 5/10: Final DPA redline and DocuSign circulation

Action owners:  
- Evidence uploads / owner: Connor O'Brien (connor_obrien@redwood.ai) — he'll coordinate with Neha for SOC 2 artifacts.
- Legal / DPA: Evelyn (that's me) + Greenstream Legal to run redlines.

I'll attach the MAP template now and put the pre-populated SIG-lite by tomorrow morning. If the retention windows you listed are non-negotiable, flag that now so we surface it early.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_MAP_Template.xlsx

Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-21T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Security intake & evidence timeline for Greenstream (SIG-lite + DPA addendum)

Emma, Evelyn — quick tech + ops follow-up. I skimmed the Greenstream_Security_Reqs_v1.pdf and sketched what we can provide by 4/22 and what will need a short collection window.

What we can deliver by 4/22 (pre-populated/attachments in shared MAP sheet):
- SOC 2 report (PDF) + control narrative (we'll include mapping to your SIG-lite items)
- CAIQ matrix exports for our most common services and a pre-populated SIG-lite mapping (approx 30 controls)
- Key management summary: CMEK supported via customer KMS (AWS KMS / GCP KMS) — note: for on-prem/private deployments we can support HSM integrations.

Evidence that needs a 3–5 business day collection window:
- Granular console access records for sandbox/test VPCs (we'll collect scoped logs and redactions)
- Example escalation-runbook pages for data breach procedures (screenshots and exec summary)

Retention and residency notes: 
- Default retention tiers: Sandbox logs 30d (configurable down to 7d), PII staging 90d (can request shorter but requires proof of deletion workflows), Production request logs 365d.
- We can provide EU-residency split via our Private deployments (we'll include region-specific certs). For Greenstream, we assume US-region primary unless you request EU-residency binding.

I've added Neha as the evidence coordinator for SOC 2 artifacts — Neha: can you confirm availability to collect the console logs and runbook snapshots by 4/27?

Also: Greenstream requested a temporary SLA exception (99.9%) for the POC period. That's a legal/finance decision, but operationally we can support a monitored SLO and report on latency/availability during the eval.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MAP: Security intake & evidence timeline for Greenstream (SIG-lite + DPA addendum)

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. A few clarifying points before we lock dates:  

- Evidence escrow: Greenstream requires a single upload location (we prefer an S3 bucket with access controls + time-limited link). Can Redwood support ephemeral presigned upload links scoped to the evidence collection window?
- DPA redlines: we'll send our legal redline by EOD 4/26; please confirm the DocuSign link once the redline is accepted.
- SLA exception: For the POC we can accept 99.9% but we require a runbook item and a credit schedule should availability drop below that. Can Redwood outline the credit table?
- Retention final ask: we need assurance that PII staging data can be deleted on demand with a verifiable deletion record (audit trail). If deletion is asynchronous, provide max completion SLO.

Next steps from Greenwood (sic): we'll circulate the SIG-lite top40 by 4/21 (ETA slipped to 4/22) and send Legal redlines 4/26.  

Evelyn / Connor: please confirm presigned upload support and a draft credit table for the SLA exception by 4/27 so we can bake it into the MAP.

Thanks,
Rajiv Menon
VP, Platform Risk
Greenstream Bank

Attachments referenced: DPA_Addendum_Draft.docx
